# Kaveri Stays — Comprehensive Agent Specification

> Kaveri Stays is an enterprise luxury boutique hospitality platform offering curated property bookings, real-time availability tracking, guest concierge, and management dashboards across India.

## System Overview

Kaveri Stays provides five-star hospitality experiences. The system supports multi-role access control for:
- Guests: Room search, reservation booking, booking cancellation, and review submission.
- Staff: Guest check-in/check-out management, room assignment, and service requests.
- Managers: Property room inventory, rate management, and operational analytics.
- Owners: Portfolio revenue reports, occupancy metrics, and multi-property oversight.

## Core Web Pages

- [Home / Landing Page](https://kaveristays.in/): Overview of portfolio properties (Kaveri Grand Palace Mysore, Kaveri City Suites Bangalore, Kaveri River Retreat Coorg), amenities, guest reviews, and booking access.
- [Properties Directory](https://kaveristays.in/properties): Complete listing of properties with filtering by location, star rating, price, and amenities.
- [Bookings Portal](https://kaveristays.in/bookings): Reservation tracking system for guests and staff to view, filter, update, or cancel room reservations.
- [Reviews Center](https://kaveristays.in/reviews): Verified guest reviews, average ratings, detailed stay feedback, and submission modal for checked-out guests.
- [Reports Dashboard](https://kaveristays.in/reports): Revenue, occupancy, and analytics reports for managers and owners.
- [Auth Sign In / Sign Up](https://kaveristays.in/login): JWT-authenticated login, account registration, and password recovery.

## WebMCP AI Agent Tools & APIs

- [API Swagger Documentation](https://kaveristays.in/docs): RESTful OpenAPI interface details.
- [OpenAPI JSON Specification](https://kaveristays.in/openapi.json): Raw OpenAPI 3.0 schema for agentic execution.
